/* commonMapper.selectSelectedMenuTitle */ SELECT
FROM MENU M LEFT JOIN MENU P ON P.MENU_UID = M.PARENT_MENU_UID WHERE CONCAT(COALESCE(P.PATH, ''), SUBSTRING_INDEX(M.PATH, '/', 2)) = #{path} AND M.FLAG_DELETED = 'N' AND M.FLAG_ACTIVATED = 'Y' ORDER BY M.`ORDER`, M.MENU_UID LIMIT 1
/* commonMapper.selectProfileImageUrlPath */ SELECT F.URL_PATH AS profileImageUrlPath FROM USER U LEFT JOIN `FILE` F ON F.FILE_UID = U.PROFILE_IMAGE_UID WHERE U.USER_UID = #{userUid}
